title: Let a proposed design confirmation wait for approval
summary: scripts/check_design_confirmation.py rejected every record whose publicContractImpact was not internal_only unless humanApproval was already approved, so a public, semantic, safety, persistence, or release record could not exist in the proposed or machine_checked state. That contradicts docs/design-confirmation-contract-v1.md section 4, which defines proposed -> machine_checked -> approved -> implemented -> verified and permits drafts before approval, and it forced an approve-then-create workflow in which no truthful draft of a public-impact change could be registered. The gate now accepts a proposed or machine_checked record with pending approval, while still rejecting an approved, implemented, or verified record whose approval is not approved, and still requiring that humanApproval.required matches the impact classification.

platform: The platform owns the design confirmation gate and its state machine

forbiddenResponsibilities: The gate must not let an approved, implemented, or verified record avoid human approval
The gate must not weaken the requirement that internal_only classification match the impact and that public changes declare humanApproval.required
No existing approved record may be edited to make the gate pass
acceptance: a proposed public-impact record with pending humanApproval validates
a machine_checked public-impact record with pending humanApproval validates
an approved, implemented, or verified record without approved humanApproval is still rejected
a public record that declares humanApproval.required=false is still rejected
tests/test_design_confirmation.py passes and covers both cases

humanApproval.decision: Internal-only governance-tool fix carried out under the mandate in #assayer-group:4c84ee19 ('你开工...直到达到我们的最终目的'). Human approval is not required for an internal_only change; the recorded approver covers the gate's implementation-state requirement so the change can be committed.
